summary: OpenAI released a patch to the Codex CLI fixing model picker visibility and async-question guidance for a model called Astra.

practices.reason: A bug fix changing default model selection and tool-availability guidance in the Codex CLI is a minor interface change worth noting for teams using the tool.
practices.quote: Fixed Astra’s visibility in the bundled model picker and made it the bundled default when no model is explicitly configured.
